[Alghollthu Lash](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1881)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 35 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Whip](/Weapons.aspx?ID=48)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This fleshy _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [whip](/Weapons.aspx?ID=48)_ is obviously crafted from the tentacle of some fearsome beast, likely an [alghollthu](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=1), and constantly drips slime.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command,;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The next creature you successfully Strike with this weapon is exposed to _alghollthu slime_.

 **Alghollthu Slime** ([curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) **Saving Throw** DC 25 Fortitude; **Stage 1** no ill effect (1 round); **Stage 2** the victim's skin softens, making the creature [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) (1 round); **Stage 3** the victim's skin transforms into a clear, slimy membrane, making it drained 2 until the curse ends; every hour this membrane remains dry, the creature's drained condition increases by 1 (permanent). A [_remove disease_](/Spells.aspx?ID=251) spell can [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) this curse, but immunity to [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) offers no protection against it.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a tentacle from an alghollthu.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
